description: This file defines the EmployeeTimeAtWorkDao class in the OrangeHRM system, responsible for accessing attendance records of employees, including retrieving the latest, records within a date range, and open attendance records.

classes.name: EmployeeTimeAtWorkDao
classes.description: Data access object for employee attendance records, extending BaseDao, providing methods to retrieve attendance data for specific employees.

methods.name: getLatestAttendanceRecordByEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent attendance record for a given employee number.

methods.name: getAttendanceRecordsByEmployeeAndDate
methods.description: Retrieves all attendance records for a specific employee within a specified date range.

methods.name: getOpenAttendanceRecordByEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves an open (punched in but not punched out) attendance record for a given employee.
